notes.title: Ver 1.20 - No more Guess Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092307/37d3805b462a4dcb00d3c21bc088c25c00806f13.png

Ver 1.20 - No more guess updtae

So, All puzzles are solvable in Click Painter. (Except custom mode).

Up until now,  Classic Mode and some of the starting points in Story Mode could require some guessing.
As of this update, All puzzles in Story Mode and Classic Mode are guaranteed to be solvable.
For Custom mode, the game will try to find a solvable starting point, but not always succeed in finding a solvable starting point.

Thank you for reading, and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Ver 1.10 - QoL Update 1
notes.notes:
New Feature 1 - Fixed Color mode
Fixed color mode is updated to use fixed colors that are easy to see regardless of the current stage palette.
you can activate the fixed color mode by clicking toggle in stat UI at top left corner. When you enable Fixed Color Mode, the colors used in play will change to a fixed colors. Please refer to the screenshot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092307/84275e3417887cbdb159aa2b484f9aceb69cbde4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092307/c6171535d6b528e8110cc8f16715334d019ee138.png

New Feature 2 - Golden Eraser
Now, when you replay a cleared stage, you will start with the Golden Eraser enabled.
Mistakes that occur while the Golden Eraser is active will deactivate the Golden Eraser instead of consuming the eraser.
You can tell if the golden eraser is active by looking at the sprite.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092307/197f8020c2b77e028e659b9c17946437d80acdcf.png

Others
When you press a number tile to open the surrounding tiles, only mistakes are checked for color tiles.

Some other small bugs have also been fixed.

Thank you for enjoying the game, and Have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Future update plan
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092307/37d3805b462a4dcb00d3c21bc088c25c00806f13.png

Hello, painters! I'm fallshad, the developer of Click Painter.
Many people have enjoyed Click Painter over the past two weeks since its release, and I have received a variety of feedback.

After reviewing opinions, I would like to update the following features:

 Remove "Guess" situations in classic mode and some starting points in story mode
 Convenience update, including tooltips to remind you of occasionally used features, control setting, color related options, and others as needed.
 Support for OS other than Windows
 Steam Community features for custom mode

Although I cannot guarantee quick updates as I'm a solo developer, I will update the above contents within the first half of the year if possible, or within the third quarter at the latest.

Thank you for playing, Please enjoy, and Have a nice day! :)


P.S. I have created developer page. Please follow if you are interested in my games.
